list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query:
SELECT src_addr
FROM
(
  SELECT src_addr, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes
  FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched
  WHERE received_at >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND (startsWith(src_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR match(src_addr, '^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.'))
  GROUP BY src_addr
)
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC

panels.title: Device Throughput — 5m Duration-Aware Rollup

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    bucket_start AS time,
    sum(bytes) * 8 / 300 AS bits_per_sec
FROM flow_poc.flow_rollup_5m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
  AND (src_addr=${device:singlequote} OR dst_addr=${device:singlequote})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Duration-aware device throughput from flow_rollup_5m: sum(bytes) * 8 / 300. The 5m rollup distributes bytes/packets across flow_start→flow_end buckets to reduce IPFIX active-timeout artifacts.

panels.title: Device Flow Records/sec — Ingest Telemetry

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(received_at, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, count() / 30 AS flows_per_sec
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (src_addr=${device:singlequote} OR dst_addr=${device:singlequote})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Per-device flow record receive cadence based on received_at. This is collector/exporter telemetry, not a traffic-volume rollup.

panels.title: UDP/443 QUIC Throughput — 5m Duration-Aware Rollup

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket_start AS time, sum(bytes) * 8 / 300 AS bits_per_sec
FROM flow_poc.flow_conversation_5m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
  AND (endpoint_a_addr=${device:singlequote} OR endpoint_b_addr=${device:singlequote})
  AND proto='UDP'
  AND service_port=443
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: UDP/443 throughput for the selected device from flow_conversation_5m using service_port=443. Uses the standardized duration-aware 5m conversation rollup to include both directions and avoid raw-flow timing artifacts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT src_name, src_addr, bytes AS current_bytes, formatReadableSize(bytes) AS current_readable, baseline_buckets, formatReadableSize(avg_bytes) AS avg_readable, formatReadableSize(p95_bytes) AS p95_readable, ratio_to_avg, ratio_to_p95
FROM flow_poc.v_current_hour_device_vs_baseline
WHERE src_addr=${device:singlequote}
ORDER BY current_bytes DESC

SELECT dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND src_addr=${device:singlequote}
  AND NOT (startsWith(dst_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'192.168.') OR match(dst_addr, '^172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.'))
GROUP BY dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (src_addr=${device:singlequote} OR dst_addr=${device:singlequote})
GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT proto, dst_port, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND src_addr=${device:singlequote}
GROUP BY proto, dst_port ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Source Device Throughput — 5m Duration-Aware Rollup

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket_start AS time, sum(bytes) * 8 / 300 AS bits_per_sec
FROM flow_poc.v_rollup_device_5m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND src_addr=${device:singlequote}
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Source-side device throughput from v_rollup_device_5m: sum(bytes) * 8 / 300. Replaces the older hourly rollup for dashboard consistency.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT src_name, dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port, recent_bytes AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(recent_bytes) AS readable_bytes, recent_flows
FROM flow_poc.v_recent_new_external_destinations
WHERE src_addr=${device:singlequote}
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, proto, src_port, dst_port, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (src_addr=${device:singlequote} OR dst_addr=${device:singlequote}) AND (src_port=22 OR dst_port=22)
GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, proto, src_port, dst_port
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25
